key_concepts: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity
An object accelerates when speed, direction, or both change
Uniform motion with constant speed and direction is not acceleration
Acceleration is calculated as change in velocity divided by change in time
Negative acceleration means slowing down or deceleration
Linear acceleration occurs in straight-line motion
Curvilinear acceleration occurs in non-linear motion such as circular paths
Uniform acceleration means velocity changes at a constant rate
